raw_text: Russia has stepped up nuclear rhetoric with senior officials and state media emphasising the country's readiness to use tactical nuclear weapons, in what analysts describe as a coordinated information campaign timed to coincide with Western deliberations over new military aid to Ukraine. No changes in Russia's nuclear force posture have been detected, according to Western intelligence officials.
clean_text: BBC reports Russia stepping up nuclear rhetoric in coordinated campaign timed to Western Ukraine aid deliberations. No changes in nuclear force posture detected by Western intelligence.
